title: Pair extraction computation
statement: Let $x$ be a finite bit string and let $a,b$ be Boolean flags. The constructed machine outputs the first component of the parsed pair if $a$ is true, followed by the second component if $b$ is true; components whose flags are false are omitted, and the output is empty if parsing fails. It computes this output within $5(|x|+1)$ steps.
